name: Zhiyang Hu
title: Undergraduate at Wuhan University | AI Security Researcher
bio: Senior Undergraduate Student at Wuhan University specializing in AI Security and Generative Model Robustness.
about: I am currently a senior undergraduate student majoring in Information Security at Wuhan University (Class of 2022). My research interests lie at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Security. I am particularly focused on ensuring the safety and trustworthiness of generative models, including Diffusion Models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). My current research projects involve model watermarking, adversarial examples, backdoor attacks, and red teaming, aiming to develop robust defenses and evaluation frameworks for next-generation AI systems.
